piece:
Planks that stop in the air

I want to lay the cart's road myself, so I dropped three oak planks on the sand and let real contact decide where each one comes to rest. The first one landed fine, and in that instant the other two stopped in mid-air and stayed there: my physics takes one step limit for everything at once, from the closest contact anywhere, so one plank lying on the sand froze the ones still falling. Next each plank gets its own limit, then the cart rolls over whatever road I lay.
